page.title: Create {{name}} from git
page.body: Bayplan keeps {{name}} in sync with a folder in a git repository. Nothing is deployed until you review and deploy it.

card1.title: Repository and ref
card1.body: Choose where the stack lives and which branch, tag or commit it follows.

repo.label: Repository
repo.none: No repository is available on {{env}}. An administrator can add one under Git.
repo.clears: Changing the repository clears the folder and files you chose.

helper.tag: Bayplan follows this tag. If the tag is moved to another commit, that counts as a change.
helper.commit: A fixed commit is never behind. Change the ref to move it.

ref.capped: Showing the first 200 of {{n}}. Type to narrow.

empty.branch: No branches. The repository may be empty.

card2.title: Folder and compose files
card2.body: The folder is the stack's root. Bayplan only reads files inside it.

folder.noComposeBody: Open a folder, or pick this folder if its compose file has another name.
folder.capped: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{n}}. Filter to find the rest.

compose.title: Compose files
compose.helper: Files are merged in this order, like docker compose -f a -f b. Later files override earlier ones.
compose.noneToAdd: No other .yml or .yaml files in this folder.
compose.picked: Picked {{file}}. Change it if the stack uses another.
compose.failed: Couldn't read the files of this folder.

reasons.ref_missing: That branch or tag isn't in {{repo}} any more.
reasons.commit_ambiguous: More than one commit in {{repo}} starts with that. Use more characters.
reasons.folder_missing: That folder isn't in {{repo}} at this ref.
reasons.ref_invalid: That isn't a ref name git accepts.
reasons.offline: The server didn't answer. Check the connection and try again.
reasons.permission: You don't have permission to read this repository.
reasons.unknown: Bayplan couldn't read the repository. Try again.
reasons.compose_file_missing: A compose file you chose isn't in that folder at this ref.
reasons.compose_path_invalid: A compose file path is outside the stack folder or is named twice.
reasons.file_path_invalid: An overlay file path isn't a path inside the stack folder.
reasons.folder_invalid: That folder isn't a path inside the repository.

footer.note: Checks the repository every 5 minutes and waits for your review. Change this under Git settings.
footer.needsAll: Choose a repository, a ref, a folder and a compose file first.

errors.createFailed: Couldn't create the stack from that folder. Check the repository, ref, folder and files, then try again.
errors.nameInvalid: Use only letters, numbers, dash and underscore, starting with a letter or number.
